name: "Cacio e Pepe" Orzo Salad with Artichokes, Peas, Parsley & Parmesan

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, uncover, add orzo, and stir for a few seconds; cook until desired firmness, about 8 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
425 g orzo pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 lemons
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
1 ½ (227 g) pkgs sugar snap peas

instructions.primary_message: Zest and juice lemons into a large bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the lemon along with oil, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp salt
1 ½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Drain and thinly slice artichoke hearts. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Thinly slice green onions crosswise (at an angle). Add the white and pale green parts to the bowl. (Reserve dark green parts for serving.)
Place frozen peas in a colander and run under warm water (from the tap) to thaw. Add to the bowl.
When the orzo is done, drain in a colander, then add to the bowl with the dressing and veggies. Stir to combine and set aside to cool, 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, thinly slice snap peas crosswise (at an angle).
Once the orzo is cool, add Parmesan and snap peas to the bowl. Stir once more to combine the salad.
To serve, divide orzo salad between plates or bowls. Top with reserved green onions and season with pepper. Enjoy!
